newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEEK MIXED ON HARD UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEEK MIXED ON HARD UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker on the U.S. unit and the rand but was trading firmer against sterling and the mark at the start of the week on Monday, dealers said.

Dealers said the local currency's bid/offer spread against the key U.S. dollar, which was reduced to one-and-a-half points from two at the start of the year, had narrowed further to one point with effect from Monday.
"This is all to further develop our market. It should increase turnover and generally bring us more in line with international markets," one dealer said.

At around 0720 GMT, the Zimbabwe dollar was indicated at 10.9600/9700 against the U.S. unit from Friday's 10.9550/9700 and and was also marginally easier on the rand at 2.4069/4206 compared to 2.4000/4100.
Against sterling, however, it edged up to 17.5612/5882 from 17.5700/6100 and was at 6.6687/6788 from 6.7000/7200 versus the mark.
